method: Deterministic solo and two-player Rhino scenarios using the actual game loop, controllers, messages, costs, resource payments, rendered target choices, status cards and response windows. Puzzle commands establish controlled board/deck states; card rules are not mocked. Includes complete villain phases and round transitions.
printed_text_source: Local experimental card metadata transcribed from the pack references; the exact text checked is included per card below.

validation.counting: Counts unittest test methods once, not repeated runs or parameterized subcases.
validation.reproduce: .venv-release\Scripts\python.exe -X utf8 -m unittest unit_test.test_jj_luke_first_pass unit_test.test_jj_engine_support unit_test.test_jj_hero_gameplay unit_test.test_luke_hero_gameplay unit_test.test_jj_luke_nemesis_gameplay unit_test.test_jj_luke_multiplayer_gameplay unit_test.test_form_change_lifecycle unit_test.test_overkill_damage_modifiers unit_test.test_bulletproof_belle_boost_damage unit_test.test_resource_cost_reduction unit_test.test_kingpin_side_scheme_reveals unit_test.test_fear_no_evil_player_cards unit_test.test_fear_no_evil_modular_sets unit_test.test_wonder_man_jarvis unit_test.test_thwart_target_restrictions unit_test.test_attached_identity_restrictions unit_test.test_attached_health_flip unit_test.test_optional_choice_confirmation unit_test.test_end_phase_hand_limit unit_test.test_v18_timing_integration unit_test.test_purple_man_obligation_readiness unit_test.test_sense_enemy_defeat unit_test.test_attack_defender_player unit_test.test_victory_defeat -q

fixes.issue: Camcorder offered targets without enough evidence because a prebuilt finder bypassed the extra filters.
fixes.change: Use an explicit Minion/ELITE/affordability selector and pay evidence as a cost before discarding the minion.

fixes.issue: Circumstantial Evidence only observed damage-caused defeats, missing Alias Investigations.
fixes.change: Respond to the generic enemy-defeated event; discard still does not count as defeat.

fixes.issue: Boost effects asserted while looking up a player initiator on an encounter-owned effect.
fixes.change: Read the activation recipient from the boost message.

fixes.issue: The shared card finder returned early after checking playability, skipping printed-resource restrictions.
fixes.change: Continue applying the remaining finder restrictions after the playability check.

fixes.issue: Selecting the play option then canceling payment avoided both playing a card and adding threat.
fixes.change: Apply 2 threat if no selected card was played, including an unavailable payment.

limits: Automated headless gameplay, not browser/UI click-through or human playtesting.
Covers the heroes' own sets and nemeses, not every aspect/basic card supplied in the packs.
Targeted scenarios are not proof of every possible interaction. Multi-villain scenarios and full campaign combinations remain unvalidated.
Experimental registration remains opt-in. Normal data/cards.json was not changed.

cards.name: * Jessica Jones
cards.printed_text: [star] Gather Evidence — Response: After you use a basic power, place 1 evidence counter on Alias Investigations.
cards.checked_behavior: Gather Evidence

cards.name: * Jessica Jones
cards.printed_text: Incognito Mode — Action: Change to hero form. You cannot change back to alter-ego form this phase. Setup: Put the Alias Investigations support into play.
cards.checked_behavior: Setup and Incognito Mode; form lock and expiry

cards.name: * Alias Investigations
cards.printed_text: Permanent. Response: After a side scheme is defeated, exhaust this card → place 2 evidence counters here. Then, you may remove evidence counters from here equal to the villain's remaining hit points to defeat the villain's current stage.
cards.checked_behavior: Evidence, exhaustion, optional stage defeat, other-player defeats

cards.name: * Luke Cage
cards.printed_text: Toughness. Action: Exhaust Luke Cage and deal 1 damage to him → give him a tough status card.
cards.checked_behavior: Toughness, consequential damage, paid action and lethal cost

cards.name: "Big Mistake"
cards.printed_text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 3 damage to an enemy. You may remove 1 evidence counter from Alias Investigations to deal 2 additional damage and for this attack to gain either overkill or piercing.
cards.checked_behavior: Paid base attack, evidence, piercing, overkill, stun replacement

cards.name: Breakthrough
cards.printed_text: Response: After an evidence counter is placed on Alias Investigations, ready your identity. Shuffle this card into your deck.
cards.checked_behavior: Ready, shuffle, counter-removal exclusion and ownership

cards.name: Snooping Around
cards.printed_text: Alter-Ego Action (thwart): Remove 4 threat from a scheme and place 2 evidence counters on Alias Investigations. Discard the top card of the encounter deck. If that card is a minion or side scheme, reveal it.
cards.checked_behavior: Thwart, evidence, encounter discard/reveal types, confusion

cards.name: * Piecing It All Together
cards.printed_text: This scheme does not count against the player side scheme limit. When Defeated: The defeating player draws 3 cards.
cards.checked_behavior: Play, side-scheme limit exception, draw and defeating-player recipient

cards.name: Calling in Favors
cards.printed_text: Alter-Ego Action: Remove 2 evidence counters from Alias Investigations and exhaust Calling in Favors → search your deck for an ally and play it as if it were in your hand, reducing its resource cost by 2. (Shuffle.)
cards.checked_behavior: Evidence/exhaust costs, deck search, discounted payment and insufficient resources

cards.name: 4K Digital Camcorder
cards.printed_text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust this card and choose a non-[[Elite]] minion. Remove X evidence counters from Alias Investigations, where X is equal to 2 less than that minion's remaining hit points → discard that minion.
cards.checked_behavior: Remaining-health evidence cost, Elite exclusion, unaffordable targets, discard versus defeat

cards.name: Circumstantial Evidence

cards.checked_behavior: Evidence for damage and non-damage enemy defeats; no reward for discard

cards.name: Leather Jacket

cards.name: "Now I'm Ticked Off!"
